comments.content: `useSystemAgents` conditionally calls `useLocalSystemAgents` or `useRemoteSystemAgents`, which violates the Rules of Hooks. If `defaultaides` changes between renders (e.g., user edits the setting), the number/order of hooks called changes, causing React errors. Refactor so the hook always calls the same hooks, and branch inside the effect/return value instead.

`useRemoteSystemAgents` reads `store.getState().settings.defaultaides` directly and returns `agents` early if it's null/undefined, before calling `useEffect`. This is another conditional hook call. Also, reading from the store via `getState()` won't trigger re-renders when the setting changes; use `useSelector` instead.
The artificial `await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500))` delay before fetching is unnecessary and will slow down agent loading. Remove it.

`defaultaides` is initialized to the literal string `'settings.defaultaides'`, which is not a URL and not a valid i18n key at this location. This will cause `useSystemAgents` to fall into the local branch (since it doesn't start with 'http'), but the value is meaningless. Initialize to `null` or an empty string.
Action name `setefaultAides` is misspelled (missing 'D'). Rename to `setDefaultAides` for consistency and to avoid confusion.

Key `defaultaides` is added under `settings.data` but the component uses `settings.data.default_aides.title` / `.repo_url` / `.repo_url_placeholder`. The key names don't match, so translations will be missing. Also `defaultaides` is misspelled (should be `default_aides`).

The `default_aides` block is added only to `zh-cn.json`. Other locales (en-us, ja-jp, ru-ru, zh-tw) add a differently-named `defaultaides` key under `settings.data`, so `t('settings.data.default_aides.title')` will fall back to the key string in those languages. Align the key names across all locale files.
File mode is 100755 (executable). Source files should be 100644. Also there are stray blank lines and the component name `DefaultaidesSettings` is misspelled; consider `DefaultAidesSettings`.
